title: Auto-sync closed-won deals to invoicing
problem: When a deal closes in Salesforce, finance re-keys the order into SAP by hand. It takes 2-3 days and about 4% of invoices have typos in amounts or PO numbers.
proposedSolution: Push closed-won opportunities to SAP as draft sales orders automatically, with a review queue for exceptions.
businessValue: Removes ~120 hours/month of manual entry and shortens days-sales-outstanding by an estimated 2 days.
successMetrics: Invoice creation within 4 hours of close; re-key error rate below 0.5%.

title: Self-service password reset for customer portal
problem: Customers who forget their portal password must call support. Password resets are 18% of all tier-1 tickets.
proposedSolution: Email-based reset link with MFA confirmation.
businessValue: Deflects ~1,100 tickets per month and improves CSAT for login issues.
successMetrics: Password-related tickets down 80% within one quarter.

comments.text: Can you share how many records this affects per month and which teams own the process today?

title: Quarterly SOX access review report
problem: Auditors need a list of who has access to financial systems each quarter. Today IT stitches it together from three exports in spreadsheets.
proposedSolution: Scheduled report joining Workday org data with SAP role assignments.
businessValue: Avoids audit findings and saves ~40 hours per quarter of IT and compliance time.
successMetrics: Report produced automatically by day 3 of each quarter with zero manual edits.

comments.text: Approved at weekly triage. Sizing with the delivery team next sprint.

title: Bulk edit for support ticket tags
problem: Support leads re-tag hundreds of tickets after taxonomy changes, one at a time.
businessValue: Saves team leads about 6 hours a week and keeps reporting categories accurate.

comments.author: Alex Rivera (PM)
comments.text: Duplicate of an item already on the roadmap for next quarter. Linking and closing.

title: Churn-risk dashboard for account managers
problem: Account managers only learn a customer is unhappy when they fail to renew. Usage and ticket signals exist but are scattered.
proposedSolution: Weekly churn-risk score per account surfaced in Salesforce.
businessValue: A 1-point reduction in gross churn is worth about $900K ARR.
successMetrics: Gross churn down 1 point year over year; 90% of at-risk accounts contacted within 14 days.
urgencyReason: Committed to a customer or auditor date; slipping has contractual consequences.

title: Automate new-hire laptop provisioning
problem: IT learns about new hires from a manager email, sometimes after the start date. 1 in 5 new hires starts without a working laptop.
proposedSolution: Trigger a ServiceNow provisioning ticket when an offer is accepted in Workday.
businessValue: Every new hire productive on day one; fewer escalations to IT leadership.
successMetrics: 98% of new hires have equipment on day one.

title: Mobile app: save items to wishlist
problem: Customers cannot save products to come back to later on mobile, so they screenshot them or abandon the session.
proposedSolution: Heart icon on product cards synced to the customer account.
businessValue: Wishlists lift return-visit conversion by 3-5% in industry benchmarks.

comments.author: Alex Rivera (PM)
comments.text: Approved at weekly triage. Sizing with the delivery team next sprint.

title: Commission statements in the sales portal
problem: Reps email finance monthly to ask how their commission was calculated, creating ~300 inquiries per cycle.
proposedSolution: Line-item commission breakdown visible to each rep.
businessValue: Reduces finance inquiries and disputes; improves rep trust in comp plan.

title: GDPR data-subject request workflow
problem: Data-subject access and deletion requests arrive by email and are tracked in a spreadsheet. We have 30 days to respond and missed two deadlines last year.
proposedSolution: Portal form that opens a tracked case with SLA timers and a checklist per system.
businessValue: Avoids regulatory fines (up to 4% of turnover) and reputational damage.

comments.author: Casey Morgan (BA)
comments.text: Approved at weekly triage. Sizing with the delivery team next sprint.

title: Marketing campaign ROI report
problem: Marketing cannot tie pipeline back to campaigns because campaign IDs are lost when leads convert.
proposedSolution: Preserve campaign attribution through lead conversion and expose it in a dashboard.
businessValue: Lets us reallocate ~$2M annual spend toward campaigns that actually produce pipeline.

title: Expense receipt capture by photo
problem: Employees keep paper receipts and upload scans at month end; many are lost, delaying reimbursement.
proposedSolution: Snap a photo in the mobile app and auto-extract amount, date and merchant.
businessValue: Faster reimbursements and fewer policy exceptions for missing receipts.

comments.text: Approved at weekly triage. Sizing with the delivery team next sprint.

problem: Pick lists are sorted by order number rather than bin location, so pickers walk the warehouse several times per batch.
proposedSolution: Sort pick lists by walking route.
businessValue: Estimated 15% pick-time reduction across 3 warehouses.
successMetrics: Average lines picked per hour up 15%.
